name: Friends and milestones
short: A 40th, a reunion or a last trip before the wedding, with one villa and everyone in it.
summary: A 40th, a university reunion, a last week away before the wedding. One villa, one plan, and nobody stuck organising it.

image.alt: Palms on a red headland above the sea at Mirissa

suits.heading: For the trip someone always ends up organising.
suits.body: We take that job. You tell us who is coming, what you are celebrating and what the group would argue about, and we plan around it.
points: Surf, dive or yoga weeks with friends

services.heading: What we look after.
services.body: Pick what you need. We quote for the whole, with nothing added later.

items.title: One house for everyone
items.body: Whole-villa buyouts on the south coast or a bungalow in tea country, with a cook and staff.

items.title: Group transport
items.body: A van or a mini coach for the group, with a driver who stays for the week.

items.title: The big night
items.body: A private dinner on the beach or the fort ramparts, with music, a cake and someone to clear up.

items.title: Days out
items.body: Whale watching from Mirissa, a surf lesson, a safari morning, or a tuk-tuk tour of Galle.

items.title: One bill, split fairly
items.body: A clear quote per person, so the organiser is not chasing everyone for money.

shapes.heading: Shapes we often plan.
shapes.lede: Ideas to react to, not fixed tours. Every one is changed for the group.

items.title: The south coast villa
items.body: One house above the sea near Tangalle or Galle, a chef, and a boat day in the middle.

items.title: Surf week
items.body: Arugam Bay from June to September, with lessons for the beginners and the reef breaks for the rest.

items.title: Hills and coast
items.body: Tea country by train, a safari morning, then a villa on the coast to finish.

questions.q: What is the smallest group you plan for?
questions.a: Six travellers. For fewer, one of our journeys tailored to you usually works better.

questions.q: Can people join for part of the trip?
questions.a: Yes. We plan arrivals and departures for each traveller and adjust rooms and transport around them.
